title: Source-depth improvement retains a frozen point-error miss
claim: On the same eight respiratory CT correspondences, BR-028 added the full source CT and Sol improved from BR-024’s 12.731 mm RMS / 32.203 mm maximum error to 2.604 / 6.412 mm. The unchanged frozen score still fails at q06; the user separately accepted its appearance on visual review. A retained input-legal author matcher passed using the earlier 2D source condition at 2.133 / 3.416 mm.
limitations: BR-028 supplies both full 3D CT volumes in addition to the earlier oblique slice and query geometry; the target and reference answers remain unchanged.
Input context and the solver’s chosen strategy both changed across fresh attempts, so the improvement is not a causal estimate of source depth.
The author matcher demonstrates feasibility, not blinded human performance. User visual acceptance is not independent clinical adjudication and does not replace the 3 mm RMS / 5 mm maximum gates.
The full-source solver recovered through broad 3D patch search after global fields failed, but no single saved executable rule captures all final candidate selections.
